🚨 Traffic Advisory – Special Olympics Law Enforcement Torch Run Rolling Closure 🚨

On Thursday, July 10, from  6 p.m. to 8 p.m., expect lane closures and traffic delays as the Special Olympics Law Enforcement Torch Run makes its way through the city, from the War Memorial at Brant Avenue and West Street to the Wayne Gretzky Sports Centre on North Park Street in support of the 2025 Special Olympics Ontario Provincial Summer Games.

🚧 Rolling road closures will follow this route:
 📍 Start at War Memorial Park (Brant Ave. @ West St.)
 ➡️ North on West Street
 ➡️ Right on Darling Street
 ➡️ Left on Market Street 
 ➡️Continue north on Market Street
 ➡️ Right on West Street
 ➡️ Left on Charing Cross Street
 🏁 Finish at the Wayne Gretzky Sports Centre
Please plan ahead, expect minor delays, and cheer on the run as it brings the Flame of Hope into Brantford!
#TorchRun2025 #SpecialOlympics2025
